items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded boxes and tools with no prints, high detail. Palette: warm white painted brick walls, light grey concrete floor, white oak, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. The inside of a tidy British single garage seen from the open up-and-over door. Along the left wall: tall sturdy metal shelving units fixed to the wall holding matching clear lidded storage boxes in neat rows. On the back wall: a pegboard above a simple wooden workbench with a few hand tools hanging on hooks. On the right wall: two bicycles hung vertically on wall hooks and a row of garden tools on a wall rail. The middle of the floor is completely clear. Soft daylight.
